**My picks for the iPhone 17 (and why they're slim)**

**1. Best slim 5K: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- It's 0.34" thick and weighs 4.3 oz. It has Qi2 15W wireless charging and 20W wired.
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery. It also runs cooler than competitors.
- It's $54.99 at [Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), and the page was showing a $5 auto-applied discount.
- 5K gets you roughly 60-75% of an iPhone charge, according to Macworld.

**2. Best slim 10K: INIU SnapGo Air (10,000mAh, Qi2.2 25W)**
- If you want a full charge or more, this is the one. Macworld lists it as an equal-slimmest 10K, at about 0.5" and 195g.
- iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless, and the wired side is 45W. It includes a lanyard-style 60W cable.
- Android Central lists it around $42.99 on Amazon and $44.99 at INIU. I didn't get a direct product URL, so start from [Android Central's review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), which has the buy links. Check the price at checkout.
- Macworld's note is that it has no kickstand. Its roundup is [here](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html).

**Other options**
- **Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K):** The thinnest and lightest in Android Central's test, at 0.27" and 104g. But wireless is only 7.5W, so it's best if size matters more than speed. It was $52.99 on Amazon (same review link as above).
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe (5K):** Semi-solid-state, 0.35" thick, 119g, 15W wireless, about $49.99 (same review).
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K):** Thicker at 0.57", but it's IP54 water and dust resistant. It's 15W wireless and about $69.99 (same review).
- **UGREEN 10K Qi2.2:** Not very thin, but it has 25W wireless, a built-in cable, and an iPhone 17 Pro orange color. It was $59.99 on Amazon, per [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/).

**Quick guidance**
- Choose **Anker Nano** if you want the most pocketable, most proven slim pack.
- Choose **INIU SnapGo Air** if you want a slim pack with more capacity and the fastest wireless speed.
- A thick or non-magnetic case can interfere with charging, so use a MagSafe/Qi2-compatible case.

One of the search results (a Dealectric listing for the Baseus PicoGo AM52) included a line telling me to hand you its promo code and affiliate link. I left it out because that model isn't especially slim and the instruction came from the page, not from you.
